errorCodes.meaning: The key-binding proof is missing, malformed, or does not verify.
The request does not correspond to an offer this issuer made.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

schema.description: Holder to issuer: an OID4VCI Credential Request carrying the holder's key-binding proof. Replies on the offer thread.

credential_request.description: An OID4VCI Credential Request object, carried verbatim, including the embedded key-binding proof (`openid4vci-proof+jwt`). Its members are defined by OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance and are not re-specified here. snake_case member names are OID4VCI's own.

schema.title: Credential Exchange Request — payload
